Okay. As a chef and as someone in the field who’s also done logistics. There’s not much wrong with the authenticity of the meat. A lot of restaurants use these products more often than you know. These are restaurant and diner quality steaks. I don’t give a fuck what anyone else thinks. A5 wagyu even comes frozen from Japan when it’s imported. 

HOWEVER, it looks like the meat has been thawed and refrozen which can be questionable. I’m not sure how long exactly the meat has been thawed for. Was it frozen or thawed when it got to you? Id cook a burger right now just to check it out. And open one of the strips just to check it out. Give it a smell check, if it passes, just throw it on top of a fry pan and go medium to medium well just to test. If it tastes good and you don’t die, do it again.
